Polygons

custom_objects.py: Classes for polygons and specialized geometric shapes within a geometric scene.

Defines general Polygon and its subclasses including CyclicPolygon, RegularPolygon, and various specific polygons like Triangles, Quadrilaterals, and their special cases (e.g., EquilateralTriangle, Rectangle, Square).

These classes encapsulate geometric properties, constraints, and relationships, enabling symbolic geometry modeling, constraint solving, and scene management.

class pygeox.custom_objects.Polygon(geoscene, *points, name=None, add_to_scene_as_type='Polygon', force_convex=False)[source]

Bases: object

Represents a general polygon defined by an ordered list of Point objects.

Parameters:

  • geoscene – The geometric scene/context to which this polygon belongs.

  • *points (Point) – The vertices of the polygon, in order.

  • name (str, optional) – Name for the polygon. If None, an automatic name is generated.

  • add_to_scene_as_type (str, optional) – Type string for scene registration. Default is ‘Polygon’.

  • force_convex (bool, optional) – If True, enforces convexity and simplicity constraint (forcing also counterclockwise direction).

Returns:

A new Polygon object registered in the scene.

Return type:

Polygon

property area

Calculates the area of the polygon using the shoelace formula.

Returns:

The area. Units: square of input coordinates.

Return type:

sympy.Expr

property centroid

Returns the vertex centroid (average of all vertices).

Returns:

The centroid as a Point object.

Return type:

Point

property circumcircle

Returns the circumcircle of the polygon if circumcenter and circumradius exist.

Returns:

The circumcircle.

Return type:

Circle

Raises:

NotImplementedError – If circumcenter or circumradius is not defined for this polygon type.

property incircle

Returns the incircle of the polygon if incenter and inradius exist.

Returns:

The incircle.

Return type:

Circle

Raises:

NotImplementedError – If incenter or inradius is not defined for this polygon type.

internal_angle_at_point(vertex_point)[source]

Returns the internal angle (in degrees) at a given vertex of the polygon, correctly handling convex and concave cases.

Parameters:

vertex_point (Point) – The vertex at which to compute the internal angle.

Returns:

Internal angle in degrees, in range (0, 360)

Return type:

sympy expression

property internal_angles

Returns the internal angles at each vertex. Angles [DAB,ABC,BCD,..] for Polygon(A,B,C,D,…).

Returns:

The internal angles at each vertex in degrees.

Return type:

list[float]

property num_sides

Returns a string representation of the Polygon object.

Returns:

String representation.

Return type:

str

property perimeter

Calculates the perimeter of the polygon by summing side lengths.

Returns:

The perimeter. Units: same as input coordinates.

Return type:

sympy.Expr

property sides: List[LineSegment]

Returns the sides of the polygon as LijneSegment objects, in order. Sides [AB, BC, CD, …] for Polygon(A,B,C,D,…).

Returns:

The sides of the polygon.

Return type:

list[LijneSegment]

class pygeox.custom_objects.RegularPolygon(geoscene, *points, name=None, add_to_scene_as_type='RegularPolygon')[source]

Bases: Polygon

Represents a regular polygon (all sides and angles equal). It imposes regularity constraints on the provided points. Defines its own reduced parameter set (center, radius, orientation).

Parameters:

  • points (Point)

  • name (str | None)

  • add_to_scene_as_type (str | None)

property area

Calculates the area of the regular polygon using its properties.

property center

Returns the center point of the regular polygon.

property circumcenter

Returns: Point: The circumcenter of the regular polygon, which coincides with the center for regular polygons.

property circumradius

Returns the circumradius of the regular polygon.

property diagonal

Longest diagonal of the regular polygon.

property height

Height (distance from one side to the opposite vertex) of the regular polygon.

property incenter

Returns: Point: The incenter of the regular polygon, which coincides with the center for regular polygons.

property inradius

Inradius (apothem) of the regular polygon.

property internal_angle

Returns: float: The internal angle (in degrees) of the regular polygon.

property orientation

Returns the orientation (rotation) of the regular polygon in radians.

property perimeter

Calculates the perimeter of the regular polygon using its properties.

property side_length

Side length of the regular polygon.

property width

Width (distance between two farthest separated points) of the regular polygon.
